script_consumption.execution_condition: The declared callback entry reaches only the listed instruction closure; all transfers resolve without mapper changes or indirect jumps, and no instruction accesses BA/BB. FA99 additionally requires its declared tile-buffer rectangle.

D2 invokes the declared callback with bank18 mapped at A000, Y=0 and mapper shadows 20/21 matching the active banks; direct transfers and constant bank switches reach the complete listed closure and restore bank18 before returning.
Callback reaches A0D4 with BA/BB at the D2 address high byte and Y in 0..1; only BA+Y+1 is read.
